changes.title: Trunk shadows
items: On foot at night, tree trunks and beach palms cast shadows from your own glow and from campfires, swinging round you as you walk

changes.title: Chart steam
items: The hot springs on the map table steam again

changes.title: Pause sliders
items: Esc's pause now slides every test slider in down the left, see-through and grouped by the change that added it (newest first), with nothing else over the game: changes show at once, and Copy values copies them all to paste back
New sliders there for the bubbles' sizes (a baby's, an adult's, a legend's)
